name: @proanima/uvcs-mcp

tools.name: uvcs_doctor
tools.description: Check cm, workspace, and UVCS MCP configuration.

tools.name: uvcs_policy_status
tools.description: Show the effective workspace identity, safety profile, allowlists, write limits, and mass-work guidance.

tools.name: uvcs_setup_status
tools.description: Show safety policy and branch/checkin/release naming setup in one place.

tools.name: uvcs_workspace_status
tools.description: Return concise workspace status.

tools.name: uvcs_pending_changes
tools.description: Return full pending changes from cm status.

tools.name: uvcs_branch_info
tools.description: Return current branch information.

tools.name: uvcs_locks
tools.description: List workspace/server locks visible to cm.

tools.name: uvcs_unity_meta_diagnostics
tools.description: Detect common Unity asset/.meta mismatches in the workspace.

tools.name: uvcs_style_rules
tools.description: Return workspace naming and release style rules.

tools.name: uvcs_style_setup_check
tools.description: Check whether workspace naming/checkin/release style rules exist. If missing, guide the model to ask the user to create them before branch work.

tools.name: uvcs_style_init_prepare
tools.description: Create .uvcs-mcp/style.json with branch naming, checkin message, and release conventions. Requires prepare/confirm. Returns a short-lived confirmation token.

preset.description: Style preset. unity is recommended for Unity teams.

baseBranch.description: Base branch for generated branches, for example /main or /main/dev.

branchPrefix.description: Optional safe prefix before branch slugs, for example PROJ-.

versionFile.description: Optional relative version file used by release planning, for example ProjectSettings/ProjectVersion.txt.

overwrite.description: Set true only when replacing an existing .uvcs-mcp/style.json.

tools.name: uvcs_style_init_confirm
tools.description: Create .uvcs-mcp/style.json with branch naming, checkin message, and release conventions. Requires prepare/confirm. Confirms and executes a prepared operation. Call only after the user has reviewed the prepared payload and explicitly approved this exact operation.

confirmPhrase.description: Must be exactly: confirm uvcs style init

tools.name: uvcs_name_preview
tools.description: Preview a branch name or checkin message from workspace style rules.

type.description: Branch or checkin type, such as feature, fix, feat, or release.

title.description: Human title used for branch slug previews.

summary.description: Single-line summary used for checkin message previews.

baseBranch.description: Optional base branch for branch previews, such as /main.

tools.name: uvcs_release_plan
tools.description: Plan a major, minor, or patch release branch, label, and comments from workspace style rules. Read-only.

releaseType.description: Optional semantic version bump type. Required when releaseVersion is omitted.

currentVersion.description: Optional semantic version. If omitted, the style versionFile is read from the workspace.

releaseVersion.description: Optional explicit release version for styles that use a user-provided version.

projectName.description: Optional safe lowercase project code for release patterns that use {projectName}.

tools.name: uvcs_diff_file
tools.description: Return cm diff output for a file inside the workspace. Output longer than 200000 characters is truncated.

tools.name: uvcs_update_workspace_prepare
tools.description: Update the workspace to the latest changeset of its branch. Local edits to files changed upstream can produce merge conflicts. Requires prepare/confirm. Returns a short-lived confirmation token.

tools.name: uvcs_update_workspace_confirm
tools.description: Update the workspace to the latest changeset of its branch. Local edits to files changed upstream can produce merge conflicts. Requires prepare/confirm. Confirms and executes a prepared operation. Call only after the user has reviewed the prepared payload and explicitly approved this exact operation.

confirmPhrase.description: Must be exactly: confirm uvcs update

tools.name: uvcs_changeset_analytics
tools.description: Analyze changesets over an optional date, branch, owner, or comment filter. Read-only.

since.description: Optional start date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

until.description: Optional end date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

branch.description: Optional branch path, for example /main or /main/release.

commentLike.description: Optional substring to match in changeset comments.

maxResults.description: Maximum changesets to return, from 1 to 500. Default: 100.

tools.name: uvcs_cleanup_candidates
tools.description: Read-only helper that lists temporary/agent branch cleanup candidates for manual review. It never deletes branches or changesets.

patterns.description: Optional semicolon-separated branch prefixes to inspect, for example /main/tmp;/main/agent.

maxResults.description: Maximum branches to return, from 1 to 200. Default: 50.

tools.name: uvcs_branch_safety_report
tools.description: Read-only helper that reports current branch, pending changes, and recent changesets before risky branch, merge, or cleanup work.

branch.description: Optional branch to inspect. Defaults to the current workspace branch.

recentChangesets.description: Recent changesets to include, from 1 to 50. Default: 10.

tools.name: uvcs_add_prepare
tools.description: Add a path to Plastic SCM / UVCS version control recursively. For Unity assets also add the matching .meta file. Requires prepare/confirm. Returns a short-lived confirmation token.

tools.name: uvcs_add_confirm
tools.description: Add a path to Plastic SCM / UVCS version control recursively. For Unity assets also add the matching .meta file. Requires prepare/confirm. Confirms and executes a prepared operation. Call only after the user has reviewed the prepared payload and explicitly approved this exact operation.

confirmPhrase.description: Must be exactly: confirm uvcs add

tools.name: uvcs_undo_prepare
tools.description: Irreversibly undo pending changes for one path inside the selected workspace. Workspace-root undo is forbidden. Requires prepare/confirm. Returns a short-lived confirmation token.

itemPath.description: Path relative to UVCS_WORKSPACE. Use a specific file or directory; the workspace root is forbidden.

recursive.description: Undo pending changes recursively below itemPath. Default: false.

tools.name: uvcs_undo_confirm
tools.description: Irreversibly undo pending changes for one path inside the selected workspace. Workspace-root undo is forbidden. Requires prepare/confirm. Confirms and executes a prepared operation. Call only after the user has reviewed the prepared payload and explicitly approved this exact operation.

confirmPhrase.description: Must be exactly: confirm uvcs undo

tools.name: uvcs_branch_create_prepare
tools.description: Create a Plastic SCM / UVCS branch from a changeset or label. Requires prepare/confirm. Returns a short-lived confirmation token.

fromChangeset.description: Optional changeset spec, for example cs:92.

fromLabel.description: Optional label spec, for example lb:RELEASE_1.

tools.name: uvcs_branch_create_confirm
tools.description: Create a Plastic SCM / UVCS branch from a changeset or label. Requires prepare/confirm. Confirms and executes a prepared operation. Call only after the user has reviewed the prepared payload and explicitly approved this exact operation.

confirmPhrase.description: Must be exactly: confirm uvcs branch create

tools.name: uvcs_label_create_prepare
tools.description: Create a Plastic SCM / UVCS label on a changeset. Requires prepare/confirm. Returns a short-lived confirmation token.

tools.name: uvcs_label_create_confirm
tools.description: Create a Plastic SCM / UVCS label on a changeset. Requires prepare/confirm. Confirms and executes a prepared operation. Call only after the user has reviewed the prepared payload and explicitly approved this exact operation.

confirmPhrase.description: Must be exactly: confirm uvcs label create

tools.name: uvcs_switch_workspace_prepare
tools.description: Switch the workspace to a branch, changeset, or label. Refused while tracked pending changes exist. Requires prepare/confirm. Returns a short-lived confirmation token.

target.description: Target spec, for example /main/task, cs:92, or lb:LABEL.

tools.name: uvcs_switch_workspace_confirm
tools.description: Switch the workspace to a branch, changeset, or label. Refused while tracked pending changes exist. Requires prepare/confirm. Confirms and executes a prepared operation. Call only after the user has reviewed the prepared payload and explicitly approved this exact operation.

confirmPhrase.description: Must be exactly: confirm uvcs switch

tools.name: uvcs_merge_prepare
tools.description: Merge a branch/changeset/label into the current workspace branch. Refused while tracked pending changes exist; the merge result stays pending until a checkin. Requires prepare/confirm. Returns a short-lived confirmation token.

source.description: Merge source spec, for example /main/task, cs:94, or lb:LABEL.

comment.description: Optional merge comment; Plastic may still require a follow-up checkin.

tools.name: uvcs_merge_confirm
tools.description: Merge a branch/changeset/label into the current workspace branch. Refused while tracked pending changes exist; the merge result stays pending until a checkin. Requires prepare/confirm. Confirms and executes a prepared operation. Call only after the user has reviewed the prepared payload and explicitly approved this exact operation.

confirmPhrase.description: Must be exactly: confirm uvcs merge

tools.name: uvcs_checkin_prepare
tools.description: Prepare a checkin of ALL tracked pending changes in the workspace (private files are not included) and return a short-lived confirmation token. Review the returned pendingChanges with the user before confirming.

tools.name: uvcs_checkin_confirm
tools.description: Run a prepared checkin of all tracked pending changes. Call only after the user has reviewed the prepared payload and explicitly approved this exact operation.

confirmPhrase.description: Must be exactly: confirm uvcs checkin

instructions: UVCS MCP exposes a bounded Plastic SCM / Unity Version Control command surface. Start with uvcs_setup_status to learn the workspace, safety profile, and naming rules. Every write is two steps: call the *_prepare tool, show its payload to the user, and call the matching *_confirm tool only after the user explicitly approves that exact operation. Never retry a confirm after WORKSPACE_CHANGED_SINCE_PREPARE or WRITE_INTERRUPTED_STATE_UNKNOWN: inspect uvcs_pending_changes and prepare again. Checkin includes all tracked pending changes in the workspace. Keep Unity assets and their .meta files together.
